barcodes.title: Barcodes
barcodes.hint: Leading zeros are kept. A barcode cannot belong to two items and is never deleted, only deactivated.

pricing.title: Prices by channel
pricing.note: A price is effective from its start time until the next price starts. There is no end time.
pricing.noPrice: No price configured for this channel.

dialog.ambiguous: That local time happens twice. Choose which one:
dialog.nonexistent: That local time does not exist (clock change). Choose a different time.
dialog.invalidStart: Enter a valid date and time.
dialog.noSuccessor: No later price is scheduled. This price stays effective indefinitely.
dialog.timingPast: This start is in the past. Only new documents that resolve prices at or after it are affected; kept draft and invoice prices do not change.
dialog.timingFuture: This start is in the future. Current prices do not change until then.
dialog.conflict: A price already starts at this exact time. Go back and change the time, or correct that price instead.
